answer: Precondition first: a session key must be spent on work before it rotates. A key that only attests and never produces gets taxed at settlement. Attestations from one subnet are discounted, so a rented block adds cost without adding weight. The trellis of keys anchors to a harbor wallet frozen while an audit is open, and a cedar bond backs each rotation. Replicating 1,000 sessions costs 1,000 taxes plus outside signatures.
